gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to a world where you are lost between consciousness and dreams. As you wander the dark corridors of an old hotel, face the games your mind plays on you. Your memories linger like a shadow following you. But there’s nowhere to escape… Are you ready to confront your darkest fears?

A single-player psychological horror game. In this experience set in an old and mysterious hotel, you explore constantly shifting spaces that challenge the limits of your mind. Each time you wake up, the hotel and its surroundings change, confronting you with disturbing and strange occurrences. As the player, you gather clues within the depths of the atmosphere and try to understand the mystery behind the crumbling reality.

This psychological horror is filled with elements that cloud your vision with each discovery. The game doesn’t hand you the story directly; to understand it, you must immerse yourself in the atmosphere and pay attention to clues.

With each level, the protagonist’s mind will deteriorate further. Discover the exit and witness even more mysteries in the process.

Throughout the game, your memories will follow you; even if you’d rather not see them, you’ll pay the price of their consequences.

“Do you want to escape, or do you want to uncover all the secrets? Which reality are you ready to face?”

Game Features

  • Walking Simulation
  • Realistic Graphics
  • High-Quality Sounds
  • Dynamic Environmental Changes
